name: IWG High Performance Conductors
old_description: International Wire Cable Services offers a comprehensive range of wire products, including bare and tinned copper wires, as well as tinned and stainless steel braids, tailored to meet diverse industry needs.
about:
International Wire, headquartered in Camden, New York, traces its origins to 1885. The company has grown through strategic acquisitions to become the largest non-vertically integrated manufacturer of copper and copper-alloy wire products in the United States.

The company produces copper single-end wire (44 AWG to 2 AWG), stranded wire, braided wire, flat wire, and copper wire on bobbins. Its in-house capabilities cover the full fabrication chain: drawing, stranding, bunching, bobbin winding, braiding, cable over-braiding, and custom harness braiding. International Wire describes its portfolio as thousands of products serving diverse industrial applications.

Customers span advanced manufacturing and automation, electrification and power infrastructure, aerospace and defense systems, data centers and critical connectivity, transportation and e-mobility, smart living and appliances, energy extraction and processing, healthcare and medical devices, and built environment and infrastructure. Specific applications include robotics, factory automation, solar farms, wind turbines, nuclear energy, in-flight entertainment and cabin management wiring, airframe conductors, 5G network infrastructure, electric vehicle systems, medical devices, and building wiring and grounding.

International Wire states its mission is to provide quality, value-oriented, copper-based products and services that exceed customer expectations, guided by core values of safety, people, customers, products and services, integrity, and continuous improvement. The company emphasizes its decades of experience in wire drawing, conductor fabrication, and custom wire solutions as a differentiator.
